findings.title: Plaintext password in provisioner connection
findings.description: A provisioner connection block with a hardcoded password stores credentials in Terraform state and version control. Use SSH keys, bastion hosts, or a secrets manager instead. The secret value is never included in findings.

evidence.expected: SSH key authentication or secrets manager reference

findings.remediation: Remove the hardcoded secret immediately and rotate it. Store secrets in AWS Secrets Manager or SSM Parameter Store (SecureString) and reference them via data sources. Never commit secrets to version control — scan history with gitleaks if the value was ever committed.

findings.title: EC2 instance without termination protection
findings.description: disable_api_termination is absent or false, so the instance can be terminated by an accidental or malicious API call. Enable it for instances that must not be deleted casually.

findings.title: EC2 instance without ebs_optimized declared
findings.description: ebs_optimized is absent, so the provider default (false) applies: the instance gets no dedicated EBS bandwidth. Declare ebs_optimized = true on EBS-backed workloads.
findings.remediation: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

findings.title: EC2 instance without an IAM instance profile
findings.description: iam_instance_profile is absent, so the instance has no IAM role: any AWS access must come from credentials baked into the image or user_data. Attach an instance profile with least-privilege permissions instead.
findings.remediation: Apply least privilege. Replace wildcard (`*`) actions and resources with the minimum scoped ARNs the workload needs. Split policy authoring from attachment. Use IAM Access Analyzer to generate scoped policies from CloudTrail history.

findings.title: EC2 root volume without encryption
findings.description: root_block_device with encrypted absent or false leaves the instance's root volume unencrypted at rest, exposing the OS disk and any data written to it. Set encrypted = true.
findings.remediation: Enable encryption at rest. For AWS-managed keys add the service's encryption block (e.g. `storage_encrypted = true` for RDS, `server_side_encryption_configuration` for S3). For regulated data use a customer-managed KMS key via `kms_key_id` and enable key rotation.

findings.title: EC2 instance without Nitro Enclaves enabled
findings.description: enclave_options is absent, so Nitro Enclaves are unavailable on this instance. Workloads that process sensitive data should enable enclave_options { enabled = true } to isolate it.
findings.remediation: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

findings.title: Provisioner executes remote commands
findings.description: A provisioner block with an 'inline' command list executes arbitrary commands on the remote host during apply (the remote-exec pattern). Provisioners are a last resort: they run outside the declarative model, often with elevated privileges, and their failures leave infrastructure half-configured. Prefer user_data, configuration management, or immutable images.

evidence.expected: no provisioners; use user_data or config management

findings.remediation: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.
